Mowing uneven.

Ok this is something that mine did recently. The cut is lower on one side and seems to miss some of the cut within the deck track.

Its usually tire related. The tires deflate over time and even a small variation will effect the deck cut characteristics. I used fix a flat because my wheels have steel rims. If yours are aluminum don't do this. Just replace the inner tube if you have one or repair it. Plug the tire if you dont.

The side where its low is the culprit. Could be front or back just check.

-----------------------

Mower will stop running after so long. If you leave it for some time it will restart. You can mow again for a while.

This happened to me today.

Its cause is vapor lock. The engine is overheating. Now mine is air cooled from the fly wheel. The cover over thr fly wheel (Disc that spins with holes in the top while running) came loose and was no longer attached.

The fly wheel motion acts as a fan to cool the cylinders and when its not working right the fuel turns into vapor which makes it impossible for the spark plug to ignite.

Just reattach the housing and it will work great.

Rattle from deck.

This noise is very easy to hear while the deck is engaged.

The problem can be from a few things. I have had it as the blade was loose. You can just tighten it, but remember the threads are reversed on some (like mine). So left is tight and right is loose.

The spindle (where the belt is attached) is loose on the housing of the deck or its going out. There are bearings inside that wear out over time. Its easier to just buy a new spindle then repair the bearing I have found. Usually they are sealed.
